terminal_conventions.transformer_2: primary_a/b identify the 38-turn winding shown connected to ANT and #1; secondary_a/b identify the 11-turn winding shown connected to #3 and the AVC rail. These labels identify circuit role only; winding polarity, inductance and coupling are not shown.
terminal_conventions.loop_3: loop_a remains the upper signal-input lead traced in v0.41; loop_b is the lower lead traced here to the upper terminal of the #2 11-turn winding. No polarity or inductance is implied.
terminal_conventions.capacitor_1: a is the terminal connected to the lower end of the #2 38-turn winding; b is the terminal on the explicit RF ground symbol. Philco labels the relevant grounds chassis for loop operation; no B− bond is inferred.
